nodes.label: caddy service (127.0.0.1:8081)
nodes.rationale: Seul service a publier un port, lie a 127.0.0.1 pour n'etre accessible que depuis la machine locale.

nodes.label: Règle n°1: never code without explicit request
nodes.rationale: Student project under evaluation: the author must understand and master everything written.
nodes.norm_label: regle n°1: never code without explicit request

nodes.label: V2.1 §1: External module access to platform data
nodes.rationale: Without access, a module working on group content would copy it into its classeur; two copies diverge and data loses its single source of truth.
nodes.norm_label: v2.1 §1: external module access to platform data

nodes.label: V2.1 §2: Export added to module contract (D11)
nodes.rationale: Right of access and portability (A3) is MVP for legal reasons; without module-side export it would cover only core data.
nodes.norm_label: v2.1 §2: export added to module contract (d11)

nodes.label: V2.1 §3: Base modules enabled by default
nodes.rationale: A newly created group is usable immediately; per-group activation principle unchanged.
nodes.norm_label: v2.1 §3: base modules enabled by default

nodes.label: Core build order (CI, schema, users/groups, modules)
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.norm_label: core build order (ci, schema, users/groups, modules)

nodes.label: Schema: utilisateurs, groupes, adhésions, invitations, demandes
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.norm_label: schema: utilisateurs, groupes, adhesions, invitations, demandes

nodes.label: Exactly one founder per group (DB-enforced)
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.rationale: Founder is a membership, not a column: unique partial index plus group created with its founder atomically; ownership transfer = two role changes.

nodes.label: A module has no door of its own (same use cases as the site)
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.rationale: A module can do nothing a member could not do with their own rights; security does not rely on the module.
nodes.norm_label: a module has no door of its own (same use cases as the site)

nodes.label: Schema: game data per set + group content (compos, classements)
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.rationale: Compo tier list is the tier of each compo, not a separate table: data lives in one place.
nodes.norm_label: schema: game data per set + group content (compos, classements)

nodes.label: Request isolation chain (group in URL, membership check, groupe en cours)
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.norm_label: request isolation chain (group in url, membership check, groupe en cours)

nodes.label: EF Core global query filters (first rampart)
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.norm_label: ef core global query filters (first rampart)

nodes.label: Two PostgreSQL roles (owner vs application), forced RLS
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.norm_label: two postgresql roles (owner vs application), forced rls

nodes.label: Session cookie (site) + service key (bot)
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.rationale: Server-side session makes exclusion/deletion immediate; role re-read each request so changes apply at once.

nodes.label: Fixed permission grid with named permissions
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.norm_label: fixed permission grid with named permissions

nodes.label: EF Core migrations applied by separate step
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.rationale: API never holds owner-role credentials; RLS/roles written as SQL inside migrations.
nodes.norm_label: ef core migrations applied by separate step

nodes.label: Core test families (domain, API isolation, DB isolation, authorization, architecture)
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.rationale: DB isolation test disables EF filters on purpose to prove the two ramparts are independent.
nodes.norm_label: core test families (domain, api isolation, db isolation, authorization, architecture)

nodes.label: Personal data lifecycle in modules (purge/anonymise/export table)
nodes.author: Cédric
nodes.norm_label: personal data lifecycle in modules (purge/anonymise/export table)

nodes.label: Graphify update once before commit
nodes.rationale: Each update costs 15-20k tokens for code, ~100k for Projet Complet.md; versioned graph must match its commit.

nodes.label: Tests are the security mechanism (never bypass CI jobs)
nodes.rationale: Every push/PR to main must build and pass all tests because isolation, architecture and hostile-module tests are the project's security mechanism; jobs must never be disabled or bypassed.
nodes.norm_label: tests are the security mechanism (never bypass ci jobs)

nodes.label: TGFT Platform
nodes.rationale: Evaluated on architecture, not features: minimal core + modules + open marketplace.

nodes.label: Cahier des charges V2.1
nodes.rationale: Extends verified-response layer so modules edit group content without copying platform data.

nodes.label: Noyau minimal
nodes.rationale: Accounts, groups, members, roles, permissions only.

nodes.label: Marketplace ouverte
nodes.rationale: Primary value is the discipline it imposes on the developer: all features go through public contracts, preventing accidental monolith.

nodes.label: Javy
nodes.rationale: JS engine compiled into the module itself, so engine bugs stay confined; JS lowers entry barrier.

nodes.label: Budget hebergement moins de 10 euros
nodes.rationale: Excludes container or database per group/module; explains many technical choices.

nodes.label: Contributeur
nodes.rationale: Produces content only; C7/C8 phrased negatively and verified by authorization tests on all endpoints.

nodes.label: Grille de permissions fixe
nodes.rationale: Fixed in code, same for all groups; customizable grid only once everything else is done.

nodes.label: Tests d'exhaustivite et de matrice des permissions
nodes.norm_label: tests d'exhaustivite et de matrice des permissions

nodes.label: Modules natifs
nodes.rationale: C# + Angular, full trust; also called modules de base, activated by default.

nodes.label: Modules externes
nodes.rationale: JS compiled to Wasm, zero trust, treated as potentially hostile.

nodes.label: Contrats partages des modules
nodes.rationale: Native and external modules share manifest, per-group activation, role permissions, purge/anonymization/export; only execution differs.

nodes.label: Team Builder
nodes.rationale: Chosen for technical richness and visual demo value.

nodes.label: Tier Lists
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the cheapest module in the catalogue.

nodes.label: Deux modules natifs engages
nodes.rationale: One module shows separation, two prove modularity; more would cost marketplace time.

nodes.label: Encodage versionne du plateau dans l'URL
nodes.rationale: Game IDs change each set (~4 months); old links must stay interpretable.
nodes.norm_label: encodage versionne du plateau dans l'url

nodes.label: Principe de la boite fermee
nodes.rationale: Each question a module could ask is another door to watch; giving everything upfront means only the response is controlled.

nodes.label: Appels serialises par module et groupe
nodes.rationale: No concurrent writes to a classeur.
nodes.norm_label: appels serialises par module et groupe

nodes.label: Couche 2 Salle des machines separee
nodes.rationale: A module escaping its sandbox finds nothing exploitable.

nodes.label: Couche 4 Classeur par module et par groupe
nodes.norm_label: couche 4 classeur par module et par groupe

nodes.label: Couche 5 Pseudonymes
nodes.rationale: Module-specific pseudonyms prevent tracking members across modules.

nodes.label: Couche 6 Interface declarative
nodes.rationale: No third-party code runs in the browser.

nodes.label: Acces des modules aux donnees de la plateforme
nodes.rationale: A module never copies platform data; it reads it and stores only references. Same use cases as the site.
nodes.norm_label: acces des modules aux donnees de la plateforme

nodes.label: Seuil plancher
nodes.rationale: Platform sets minimum role per action; module may raise it, never lower it.

nodes.label: Cycle de vie d'un module externe
nodes.norm_label: cycle de vie d'un module externe

nodes.label: Compilation attestee depuis le depot public
nodes.norm_label: compilation attestee depuis le depot public

nodes.label: RGPD
nodes.rationale: Responsible of processing; A3-A6 are MVP for legal reasons. Architecture makes compliance simple.

nodes.label: Contrat D11 anonymisation purge export
nodes.rationale: Must be in place before first module; cannot be retrofitted once the catalogue exists.

nodes.label: Limites assumees de la marketplace
nodes.rationale: No isolation is infallible: April 2026 Wasmtime sandbox escapes -> x86, default compiler, fast security updates.

nodes.label: Plan de repli Jint
nodes.rationale: If Javy+Wasmtime prototype fails; layer 2 becomes main protection; rest unchanged.

nodes.label: ASP.NET Core
nodes.rationale: Bot and machine room in same language -> data contracts checked at compile time.

nodes.label: Angular
nodes.rationale: Lazy loading aligned with modularity; renders declarative module screens.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: RLS as second rampart independent of app code; JSONB for module config.

nodes.label: EF Core et Dapper
nodes.rationale: Global query filters make isolation structural, not declarative.

nodes.label: Discord.Net
nodes.rationale: Smaller ecosystem accepted; code sharing with API wins.

nodes.label: Cache memoire et disque
nodes.rationale: No Redis: only useful multi-instance.

nodes.label: Wasmtime .NET 48 LTS
nodes.rationale: Built for untrusted code, public vuln process, 24-month LTS security fixes.

nodes.label: SQLite Microsoft.Data.Sqlite
nodes.rationale: Physical separation per module/group, purge by file deletion, size quota, no extra server.

nodes.label: Caddy
nodes.rationale: Single public entrypoint, HTTPS automation, serves Angular statics; API never exposed.

nodes.label: Data Dragon
nodes.rationale: Official static data, no API key, checked daily, behind an Application port.

nodes.label: Cookie de session et cle de service
nodes.rationale: Server-side session revocable immediately; bot uses service key; Discord tokens not kept.
nodes.norm_label: cookie de session et cle de service

nodes.label: EF Core Migrations
nodes.rationale: Applied by separate step with owner role, never by the API at startup.

nodes.label: Isolation multi-tenant structurelle
nodes.rationale: Never rely on per-query manual filters: one omission is silent.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture
nodes.rationale: Domain/Application split so IModuleRunner port lets Javy->Jint swap touch only Infrastructure; Domain referencing nothing is checkable by NetArchTest.

nodes.label: Les tests sont le mecanisme de securite
nodes.rationale: Isolation, architecture and hostile suite tests are the protection itself, blocking in CI.
nodes.norm_label: les tests sont le mecanisme de securite

nodes.label: Licence AGPL-3.0
nodes.rationale: Network clause covers software offered as a service.

nodes.label: B8 Supprimer le groupe
nodes.rationale: Only story that actually exercises the purge contract; an unexercised guarantee is not owned.

nodes.label: Bot Discord epiques J K L
nodes.rationale: No MVP stories; L4 is the most structuring: commands vary per server based on active modules.
nodes.norm_label: bot discord epiques j k l

nodes.label: Pas de modules externes en DLL
nodes.rationale: .NET no longer offers in-process isolation (CAS removed).
nodes.norm_label: pas de modules externes en dll

nodes.label: Pas de conteneur ou base par module
nodes.norm_label: pas de conteneur ou base par module

nodes.label: Pas de SQL ecrit par les modules
nodes.norm_label: pas de sql ecrit par les modules

nodes.norm_label: pas de jwt pour le site

nodes.rationale: Architecture tests first so boundaries are checked from the first line of business code.
